title: Uber/Lyft Accident in Virginia Beach
metaDescription: Uber/Lyft accident in Virginia Beach: rideshare insurance layers, VA reporting, and when to consult an attorney.
excerpt: Educational Virginia Beach, VA guide — 2-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on I-95 or surface streets in Virginia Beach can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.
Call 911 when anyone reports pain, airbags deploy, fluids leak, or traffic is blocked. Virginia Beach County dispatch will route Virginia Beach police or state patrol depending on location.
list: Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts on if traffic passes closely at highway speed
Do not admit fault — describe facts only
Request a crash report number before officers leave

sections.heading: Virginia Beach documentation checklist
paragraphs: Photograph all vehicles, license plates, VIN stickers, skid marks, traffic signals, and visible injuries. Virginia Beach insurers expect timestamped photos.
Collect names and phone numbers from witnesses — independent accounts matter on I-95, I-75, US-1 and in Virginia Beach County.
Exchange insurance policy numbers and registration; note employer if the other driver was working.

sections.heading: Medical care within 24 hours
paragraphs: Virginia Beach has Virginia Beach Regional Medical Center and Virginia Beach General Hospital among its major facilities. Level I trauma care is available at Virginia Beach Level I Trauma Center.
Whiplash, concussion, and internal injuries may appear hours later. A same-day urgent care or ER visit creates a medical record insurers cannot easily dismiss.

sections.heading: Virginia reporting rules
paragraphs: Virginia requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 30/60/20.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://www.vdot.virginia.gov/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
Virginia uses Contributory negligence comparative negligence; anything you say can affect fault allocation.

sections.heading: Evidence preservation in Virginia Beach
paragraphs: Dashcam, Ring doorbell, and business security footage near Virginia Beach downtown interchange is often deleted within 7–30 days. Send written preservation letters when appropriate.
Save repair estimates, rental receipts, and mileage to medical appointments.

sections.heading: When to explore attorney matching
paragraphs: Consider a free consultation if you were hospitalized, fault is disputed, a commercial vehicle was involved, or the adjuster offers a quick settlement before treatment finishes.
